name: @pipeworx/mcp-hospital-prices

tools.name: hospital_price_search
tools.description: What hospitals near a US ZIP charge for one service, from the standard charges files each hospital publishes under the CMS price transparency rule. Per hospital: gross charge (list price, not what anyone pays), self-pay discounted cash price, the de-identified min/max negotiated amounts, and a summary of payer-specific negotiated dollar rates; pass payer and/or plan to get that payer's negotiated rate rows. Each rate carries dollar_available: when a hospital published a percentage or formula instead of a dollar amount it says so and gives the hospital's own text rather than a number. COVERAGE IS PARTIAL AND STATED (the store is loaded state by state; each response lists the states loaded): every response says how many hospitals in range have prices loaded, why others do not (the hospital's site blocks us, no file found, ...), and distinguishes "no hospital in range", "hospital held but code absent" and "code present but payer not listed". Holds only the CMS 70 shoppable CPT/HCPCS services and MS-DRGs. Use for "what does a head CT cost near 02139", "MS-DRG 470 near 10016 for Aetna".

code.description: The service code: a CPT/HCPCS code from the CMS 70 shoppable services (e.g. "70450" head CT, "45378" colonoscopy, "99213"-style E&M codes only where on that list) or an MS-DRG number (e.g. "470" major joint replacement).

code_type.description: Optional. Inferred when omitted: 1-3 digits is an MS-DRG, a 5-character code is CPT/HCPCS.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles (1-150, default 25). Straight-line, from ZIP centroid to the hospital's ZIP centroid.

payer.description: Case-insensitive substring of the payer name (e.g. "aetna", "blue cross"). Returns that payer's negotiated rows. Major payer families are matched under their other spellings too ("blue cross" also finds BCBS / Blue Shield / Anthem; "uhc" also finds UnitedHealthcare); each hospital's payer_match says which spelling matched.

plan.description: Case-insensitive substring of the plan name (e.g. "ppo", "medicare advantage").

setting.description: Restrict to inpatient or outpatient pricing. Default: both.

limit.description: Hospitals to return (1-50, default 20), nearest first.

rates_per_hospital.description: With payer/plan: negotiated rows per hospital (1-25, default 5).

tools.name: hospital_price_compare
tools.description: Side-by-side prices for one service at up to 10 named hospitals (by CMS Certification Number, CCN, from hospital_price_search or hospital_price_coverage). Same fields and same labelling as hospital_price_search: gross charge vs self-pay cash vs payer-negotiated rates, dollar_available on every negotiated rate, and for each hospital that has no price a stated reason (not held and why / code absent / payer not listed). Use for "compare MS-DRG 470 at these three hospitals for Blue Cross".

code.description: The service code: a CPT/HCPCS code from the CMS 70 shoppable services (e.g. "70450" head CT, "45378" colonoscopy, "99213"-style E&M codes only where on that list) or an MS-DRG number (e.g. "470" major joint replacement).

code_type.description: Optional. Inferred when omitted: 1-3 digits is an MS-DRG, a 5-character code is CPT/HCPCS.

payer.description: Case-insensitive substring of the payer name.

plan.description: Case-insensitive substring of the plan name.

setting.description: Restrict to inpatient or outpatient pricing.

tools.name: hospital_price_coverage
tools.description: Whether this store holds a hospital's prices and, if not, WHY. Look up one hospital by CCN or by name (partial match), or summarise a state, or (no arguments) the whole store, including which states are loaded (the store is loaded state by state, so a hospital in an unloaded state is simply absent). Every hospital in a loaded state has a status: ok (prices held), blocked (its website refuses our requests; we do not evade blocks), not_found (no machine-readable file found), invalid_pointer, soft_404, unsupported_version, too_large, parse_error, no_matching_codes, not_fetched. Use before trusting an empty hospital_price_search, or to answer "does this tool cover Mayo Clinic".

name.description: Hospital name or part of it, e.g. "Mayo Clinic". Up to 25 matches are returned.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. "MN": counts by status for that state.

status.description: With state: list hospitals having this status (e.g. "blocked").

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hospital-prices forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hospital-prices pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
